'''Mitsuru Ogata''' (Japanese: '''小形満''' ''Ogata Mitsuru'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}. He was born on March 24, 1961 in {{wp|Aomori Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

==Pokémon roles==
Ogata has provided a few minor and additional voices for Pokémon since {{aniseries|OS}}. His most prominent role is that of all {{p|Growlithe}} in the {{pkmn|animated series}}.
